_doc: RECEIPT of the PR-queue watcher (scripts/ops/pr_queue_latency.py, fired by .github/workflows/pr-queue-watch.yml). ⚠️ READ `generated_at`, NEVER THE CRON EXPRESSION -- a merged, enabled, syntactically correct scheduled workflow in this repo is NOT evidence that it fires (probes.yml's first scheduled run was ~4h50m late and fired once instead of daily). `scripts/ci/check_pr_queue_watch.py` grades this file's age in run_guards.py on every PR, so a dead watcher announces itself in everybody's CI instead of going quiet. ⚠️ An ABSENT file means the watcher has NEVER run, which is a different fact from STALE and needs a different fix.
population: ALL 80 open, unmerged PR(s) on this repo, graded on hours since the last commit to the head branch. Drafts INCLUDED -- the convention here is 'DRAFT PR, the manager merges', so a draft is the normal hand-back shape. 0 row(s) were undateable and are excluded from the worst-wait figure.
